sections.label: What clients can expect
sections.title: What you can expect.
sections.description: The terms that apply to every project unless agreed otherwise in writing.

items.title: A written proposal
items.text: Solution, features, scope, timeline, and investment are confirmed before work begins.

items.title: Timelines per project
items.text: Each timeline is estimated for your scope rather than promised as a fixed standard.

items.title: Clear payment terms
items.text: 50% upfront and 50% before final handover, unless a different schedule is agreed in writing.

items.title: Ownership after payment
items.text: Agreed custom deliverables become yours after full payment, subject to third-party licenses.

items.title: A 30-day warranty
items.text: Reproducible issues against the agreed specification are covered for 30 days after launch or handover.

items.title: Optional maintenance
items.text: Ongoing maintenance is available separately and quoted based on your needs.

sections.title: How pricing works.
sections.description: What starting prices mean and what happens before you commit.

items.title: Starting prices are estimates
items.text: They reflect typical projects in each category. Your final price depends on your requirements and scope.

items.title: Confirmed in the proposal
items.text: The final price, scope, and timeline are confirmed in a written proposal before work begins.

items.title: Standard payment terms
items.text: 50% upfront and 50% before final handover. Larger projects may follow a different schedule, agreed in writing.

items.title: Maintenance is optional
items.text: Ongoing maintenance is not included in project prices. It can be arranged and quoted separately.
